           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
           ON CONFLICT (user_id, document_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL
           DO UPDATE SET granted_at = user_consents.granted_at
           RETURNING id, granted_at, (xmax = 0) AS "created!"
